currentWork.title: Operational evidence accumulation — FINAL.19 bring recommendation opt-in verified
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.19 is merged and live-verified. The per-machine `車から持っていく本数の提案` control is restored as strict opt-in: existing/legacy unset machines are OFF, new machines start OFF, and only explicitly ON machines can produce bring-from-vehicle recommendations or contribute to the end-of-day next-workday loading proposal. Sales observations, forecasts, generic recommendations, visit planning, OCR, tasks, orders, and normal visit completion remain unaffected when OFF. PR #111 is merged, matching Vercel production is READY, production app smoke and the dedicated opt-in gate pass, GitHub Pages serves FINAL.19, and the live opt-in gate passes. Analytics engine is AN14B3B4; DB/schema remain 4.
